item.text: {"content":"The request contains no actual 2025 sales figures or monthly metrics, and the supplied tools only generate charts; they cannot retrieve company data. Creating the dashboard requires provincial sales in millions RMB and January–December sales volumes (with units) and profit margins. Once available, the district map can display all provincial subdivisions and highlight Guangdong, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Sichuan, alongside a blue-toned column-and-line chart for monthly trends.","tool_calls":[]}
